edges.description: Pointer to 1-byte SkPaint::Style allocation is cast to uint32_t* in nextEnum, widening the type from sizeof(T)=1 to sizeof(uint32_t)=4
The cast type uint32_t determines sizeof(T)=4 in next<T>, which propagates to sk_bzero(n, sizeof(T)) as the write size

root_cause_criterion.description: nextEnum casts T* to uint32_t* regardless of T's underlying type; the cast type size must equal sizeof(underlying_type_t<T>) to prevent buffer overflow when T has a smaller underlying type
